column1: # Tab separated: <freedesktop sound name> <archive.org item> <path inside item> <sha1>
# The names on the left are the freedesktop.org sound naming spec entries that
# libcanberra and GTK applications ask for. Everything here is Microsoft
# copyright and is fetched at the user's request only — the files never live in
# Item: "Microsoft: Windows 98 System sounds (1998) winsounds.com" from the
# Do not use https://archive.org/download/<item>/<path> with plain curl here: the
# 302 it returns points at storage nodes that drop the TLS handshake on some
# networks. fetch-ms-sounds.sh resolves the node through the metadata API first.
